name: io.github.Servosity/cipp-mcp
title: CIPP MCP - Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Exchange, Defender, GDAP
description: MSP MCP for CIPP: Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Exchange, Defender and GDAP across all tenants

environmentVariables.name: CIPP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the CIPP_API_KEY credential for the CIPP MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: CIPP_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your self-hosted CIPP instance's API, e.g. https://cipp.example.com/api. The shipped default points at an example host, so until you set this the CLI is not talking to your tenant at all.

environmentVariables.name: CIPP_NO_CONFIG_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to keep credentials off disk: auth login and auth set-token refuse and nothing is written, so supply the bearer token in CIPP_API_KEY. Leave blank for the default, which keeps the minted token in the credentials file.

environmentVariables.name: CIPP_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on CIPP requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: CIPP_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to drop every MCP tool not marked read-only, cipp_execute included. Leave blank to allow writes, which run only after a preview the agent confirms.

environmentVariables.name: CIPP_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to keep no local copy of CIPP data: reads go to the API, the response cache is off, and fanout --save and --resume refuse to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: CIPP_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment); callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport Claude Desktop uses.
